fdw_oct_res.label: Octave Resolution (1/x)
fdw_oct_res.help: Target Octave Resolution: Sets the fractional octave smoothing (e.g., 12 for 1/12th oct).

fdw_max_cap_ms.label: Max Window Cap (ms)
fdw_max_cap_ms.help: Optional cap (ms) on the maximum window length. Will limit oct res at LF.

enable_auto_gain.label: Enable Auto Gain
enable_auto_gain.help: Enable global normalization across all files in the batch.

target_peak_db.label: Target Peak (dB)
target_peak_db.help: Target peak level (dBFS) for the loudest file in the set.

smoothing_oct_res.label: Smoothing Octave Res (1/x)
smoothing_oct_res.help: Auto = octave resolution x2 so that smoothing does not reduce resolution of initial FDW.

fdw_windows_per_oct.label: Windows per Octave
fdw_windows_per_oct.help: Windows per octave. Interpolation is performed in complex domain between windows.

peak_detect_threshold_db.label: Peak Detect Threshold (dB)
peak_detect_threshold_db.help: Peak detection finds loudest peak, then searches for earlier peaks above this threshold. A reflection may be louder than the true direct sound peak.

freq_start_hz.label: Start Frequency (Hz)
freq_start_hz.help: Lower boundary of the acoustic origin search.

freq_end_hz.label: End Frequency (Hz)
freq_end_hz.help: Upper boundary of the acoustic origin search.

target_n_max_origins.label: Max Harmonic Order (N)
target_n_max_origins.help: Max cap on the spherical harmonic order.

initial_simplex_step.label: Initial Simplex Step (mm)
initial_simplex_step.help: Size of the initial Nelder-Mead simplex.

max_iterations.label: Max Iterations
max_iterations.help: Maximum amoeba optimization steps per frequency.

grid_res_mm.label: Grid Res (mm)
grid_res_mm.help: Resolution of the physical grid slices.

plot_results_origins.label: Show Validation Plot
plot_results_origins.help: Launch the interactive Validation UI after search completes.

hold_origin_lf.label: LF
hold_origin_lf.help: Hold the lowest tested coordinate below the origin test range. When off, apply no coordinate shift below the range.

hold_origin_hf.label: HF
hold_origin_hf.help: Hold the highest tested coordinate above the origin test range. When off, apply no coordinate shift above the range.

fdw_rft_ms.label: Reflection Free Time (ms)
fdw_rft_ms.help: Imported from project.json. Reflection-free time used with the FDW octave resolution recorded in the Stage 1 NPZ to calculate the Stage 3 boundary.

freq_start_hz.label: Lower Test Range (Hz)
freq_start_hz.help: Editable lower test frequency. Set from RFT restores the calculated boundary, rounded up to 1,000 Hz.

test_order_range.label: Test Order Range (min, max)
test_order_range.help: Range of orders N to test.

octave_resolution.label: Octave Resolution (1/x; 0 = all bins)
octave_resolution.help: Test frequencies at 1/x-octave spacing: 12 = 1/12 octave, 24 = 1/24 octave. 0 tests every positive frequency bin in the range. Finer spacing takes longer. All Stage 3 diagnostics use these frequencies.

spl_sphere_points.label: Directivity-change sphere points
spl_sphere_points.help: Approximately uniform directions. More points can catch narrower directivity features but take longer.

spl_radius_m.label: Directivity-change sphere radius (m)
spl_radius_m.help: Fixed sphere centred on the measurement coordinate origin. It should enclose the source.

target_n_max.label: Target N Max
target_n_max.help: Hard upper cap on harmonic order N, applied after the KR limit and order-table limit.

condition_preflight.label: Optimise order growth before solve
condition_preflight.help: When Use manual order table is unchecked, optimise the current maximum N and KR growth before solving. Each order is delayed to at most three times its original entry frequency, then activated even if the condition target is exceeded. The optimized schedule is kept separate from your manual table. Disable for pure KR growth.

kr_offset.label: KR Offset
kr_offset.help: Shifts the growth of Order N with frequency.

use_manual_table.label: Use manual order table
use_manual_table.help: Use your manually entered order table and bypass growth optimisation. Uncheck to use automatic growth, with optimisation if enabled. The optimizer never changes your manual table.

noise_floor_max_db.label: Noise Floor Max (dB)
noise_floor_max_db.help: Threshold where damping reaches maximum strength.
